name: KAISER 2 CARBON

real.trim: 3.0 straight six twin-turbo, 460 PS; ADRO carbon aero kit (cosmetic)

specs.notes: BMW M's M2 (G87) wearing ADRO's carbon-fibre aero kit: the S58 3.0 twin-turbo straight six at 460 PS and 550 N m, rear-wheel drive, an eight-speed automatic (a six-speed manual offered), ~1,725 kg, 0-100 km/h in 4.1 s. The kit is cosmetic here. Its torque curve and aero are estimates. Its gearbox is BMW's for the automatic (media information, 10/2022: 5.000 / 3.200 / 2.143 / 1.720 / 1.313 / 1.000 / 0.823 / 0.640 on a 3.154 final drive), with its limiter at 285 km/h (the M Driver's Package's; 250 without); before October 2026 a 5.37 final drive ran it into the rev limiter in eighth at 285 km/h.

garage.blurb: The little M with a big carbon kit: rear-drive, six cylinders, a short wheelbase, and it loves to slide.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/m2_adro.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
